title: Reranking, NFCorpus (50 candidates per query)
decision: how well a retrieved passage supplies what a query asks for; the candidates of a query are ranked by the answer

source.name: system1-rerank-bench (BEIR SciFact and NFCorpus test queries with hybrid-search candidates)

licence: candidate lists: MIT (system1-rerank-bench); NFCorpus texts and judgments: licence not confirmed on a primary page
notes: All 100 queries with all their candidates (the row cap does not apply to ranking tasks). Graded judgments of the candidates: {0: 4302, 1: 594, 2: 104}; 698 of the 4748 judged-relevant documents are among the candidates, so a perfect reranker stays below 1. `gold` is only the placeholder the format requires (3 = highest grade of the set, 2 = a lower positive grade, 0 = not judged relevant); the metric uses meta.relevance and meta.ideal_gains. The rubric wording is the one registered in the source test for decision models, one passage per request.
